userReport: SMB Store feeds Nuvemshop; the ecommerce was linked to Nuvemshop during development with Antigravity. User has access to both providers.

observations.storefrontDataSource: Prisma reads persisted products from the ecommerce database
observations.catalogCopyScript: scripts/import-main-hml-catalog.mjs copies the reviewed source database catalog into homologation; it is not a Nuvemshop API synchronization service

codeAndHistory.searchScope: Working tree including ignored source files outside build/dependency directories; fetched main and homologacao refs, isolamento ref and available Git history; relevant text artifacts in local Antigravity brain
codeAndHistory.historicalDocumentFinding: Nuvemshop fields described as inactive without active synchronization code

limitations: Local database records establish recorded import/synchronization history, not authenticated proof of provider-side processing or current synchronization.
No later StockSyncLog entries does not rule out an external routine that does not write this table.
Empty local/database configuration fields do not establish that external deployments lack credentials.
External product IDs include previously identified tests; mapped-product count is not the commercial-product count.
The external order ID and webhook signature flag were not verified against Nuvemshop.
Provider dashboards, installed app configuration, registered webhook destinations and remote runtime logs were not accessible in this investigation.
No claim that the earlier integration never existed, was deleted, or is currently operating.
nextEvidence: Identify the installed app linking this ecommerce to Nuvemshop and the actual webhook destination, without sharing tokens or signed query strings.
Identify the deployment or script owner and obtain recent execution metadata for catalog/stock synchronization.
Correlate a product and variant across SMB Store, Nuvemshop and ecommerce, with timestamps and recent changes.
Verify that a recorded ecommerce order reached Nuvemshop and SMB Store before attempting any new write or reenabling synchronization.

followUp.note: Original observations above describe the earlier read. The follow-up authenticated consultation confirms the existing external order and current catalog, without proving continuous synchronization.
